rv.q: With empathetic and passionate performances from Tori and Roberts, it adds up to a suitably otherworldly look at poetry and love that still feels embodied in the very earthly qualities of the writers at the heart of the story.
The play deserves to be a definitive point in the life of Water People Theater.

North & Sur by Oscar Perdomo Marín, in its world premiere production by Water People Theater, is an engrossing, site-specific evening of theatre about an imagined meeting between a poet from the North, the enigmatic bard from Boston Edgar Allan Poe, and a poet from the South, the Argentine female poet Alfonsina Storni.

cn.t: Critics praise this lyrical, site-specific production about an imagined meeting between Edgar Allan Poe and Alfonsina Storni as engrossing and bold, with strong performances bringing together two literary icons.
